title: ChatColourMod
description: Allows you to change your default Minecraft chat colour to a multiple selection of colours!
body:
# What is this mod about? 
Chat Color Mod is a simple client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that lets you customize the color of chat messages. It includes full Mod Menu integration, allowing you to enable or disable the mod, choose from multiple preset chat colors, and decide whether system messages should also be recolored. Your settings are saved automatically, making it an easy way to personalize the in-game chat experience without changing gameplay.
